fee_notes: Standard fee is $55,000. Veterans and first responders receive $10,000 off. ADA subsequent clubs are 75% of standard ($41,250). No initial franchise fee if purchasing existing club (transfer fee instead).
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a $55,000 initial franchise fee for your first HA VEN Club franchise. If you are an honorably discharged veteran you may receive $10,000 off of your initial franchise fee. First responders are eligible to receive $10,000 off of the initial franchise fee.
